summary: Courtney Butte: ODF three-story enclosed cab built 1955 near Flora, Wallowa Co.; sold to private owners, now a guest house; NHLR lists it for rental.

facts.status_note: Standing on private land. Access accounts conflict: firelookout.com says there is no public access, while the NHLR entry lists it as available for rental.
facts.agency: Oregon Department of Forestry (built 1955); private owner today

access.note: Private land. A 2022 trip report says visits require the owner's prior permission. The NHLR lists the site as available for rental (2017 entry).

events.note: Site used in the 1950s as a combined fire observation and Ground Observer Corps station

ODF lookout built. The annual report describes a new 14x14 combination lookout, garage and crew house at a cost of $1800, plus a quarter mile of road. firelookout.com describes a 3-story enclosed ODF cab built in 1955.
Fence installed around the lookout and a new toilet built
Marilyn White listed as lookout personnel
Guy and Mildred Murrill listed as lookout personnel, 1958 to 1970
Roof painted International Orange to facilitate air identification
Last year of the Murrill tenure listed on firelookout.com (1958-1970)
Used for emergencies into the early 2000s
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on January 26, 2017; listed as available for rental

corrections.why: firelookout.com and Cheryl Hill both give 4,813 ft (about 1467 m), and The Roaming Civic also gives 4,813 ft. The NHLR figure of 4,387 ft (1,337 m) is the outlier.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR gives 4,387 ft; firelookout.com, Cheryl Hill and The Roaming Civic give 4,813 ft. The story reports both and the record uses the majority figure.

The 1955 annual report describes a 14x14 combination lookout, garage and crew house; firelookout.com describes a 3-story enclosed ODF cab built in 1955. The sources do not say whether they are the same building, so the story reports both.

firelookout.com says there is no public access and a 2022 trip report says visits need the owner's permission; the NHLR entry lists it as available for rental. Access is recorded as private with owner control.

sources.title: Courtney Butte – Every Lookout in Oregon

notes_for_editor: Build year 1955 and the ODF ownership history agree across sources; the building description (14x14 combination lookout vs 3-story enclosed cab) and the access status (NHLR rental listing vs no public access) conflict. The story says the sale date is unknown. Staffing names come from firelookout.com only. The 2022 owner details come from a visit report, not an owner statement. Brief elevation_m 1337.2 is the NHLR figure and is outvoted by three sources. No rental listing was verified.
